background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P on a positive outlook and A1 from Moody's. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median, while leverage of 5.6% is in the top quarter against 4.9%. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 160% above the peer median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter, though both have come down since 30 Jun 2025, LCR by 26 points and NSFR by 8 points. The one flagged item, on 18 Jun 2026, is a regulatory fine. The strongest liquidity of the HSBC entities held here.
